title: A Blast Flattened 80 Million Trees and Left No Crater

scenes.text: A blast flattened 80 million trees. And it left no crater.
It happened over Siberia on June 30th, 1908.
The trees fell flat over about 830 square miles, bigger than most major cities.
Scientists think a space rock exploded in the air, miles above the ground.
That is why there is no crater. The shock wave did all of it.
People hundreds of miles away were knocked off their feet.
It is called the Tunguska event.

description:
In 1908, a space rock exploded over Siberia and flattened about 80 million trees, with no crater at all.
The shock wave knocked people off their feet hundreds of miles away.
What do you think would happen if it hit a city?
first_comment: What would a blast like this do to a city?
